integration_issues.issue: Collect Bill modal does not open when order has unconfirmed web-edit items (APS ₹1 unconfirmed). Expected: Bill modal should open OR show clear error. Actual: silent non-response.

action_items: BUG-702: Need a web/scan order WITH variation items on TGK to verify variation label+price display. Consider placing a test order with a variation item on TGK.
BUG-672: Need a prepaid delivery order that is fully confirmed (not in web-edit state) to test Credit payment flow. The Collect Bill appears blocked on orders with pending unconfirmed items.
CR-559: If KOT auto-print on Accept needs hard verification, must actually accept the test order and check for print toast/network call to printer-agent endpoint.
BUG-672 UX issue: Collect Bill button gives no feedback when blocked by unconfirmed items — should show a clear error or disable with tooltip.
critical_code_review_comments: CR-561 implementation: Price input correctly appears only when onPriceChange prop is passed (non-readonly). In readonly mode it shows 'Price TBD' pill. This is correct behavior per OD-557-01.
BUG-679 implementation: isCancelled check at PopoutItemRow L74 is correct (status==='cancelled' OR foodStatus===3). Strikethrough via textDecoration:'line-through' on the name span.
BUG-741 implementation: The per-item cancel dialog title is set by DashboardPage's handleCancelItemFromPopout — not visible in ScanOrderPopOut.jsx itself. Confirmed working from live test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TGK popup is Mode B (web-edit) order t2 Dine-In with 1 APS new item (melo fish) and 14 prev items. CR-545/BUG-679/CR-557/CR-561/CR-552/BUG-741 all PASS. Need: (1) order with variation to test BUG-702, (2) confirmed prepaid delivery order to test BUG-672 Credit flow. Popup persists until accepted/rejected — snooze keeps popup open (by design). Collect Bill blocked on orders with unconfirmed web-edit items.
